detail: 13/13 after uintptr_t fix (Quasar DM pointers are 64-bit)
29/29; ttnn.add replaced by to_layout as the preceding program (add is Metal 1, refused on Quasar)

what: The target page does not say Quasar DM cores are 64-bit; casting a DFB lock pointer to uint32_t fails to compile (loses precision).
suggest: Add to Cluster model: DM harts are RV64, so use uintptr_t for L1 address arithmetic in DM kernels.

what: The design names ttnn.add as an example of the program to run before the op in a session test, but ttnn.add is a Metal 1 op that Quasar refuses (DataMovementKernel not supported).
suggest: Planner and target page should name a tt-metal program that runs on Quasar (ttnn.to_layout) for the run-after-another-program test.

what: The prompt requires kernels/reshape_compute.cpp even though the design (binding) has no compute kernel, so the file name ends up on a DM relayout kernel.
suggest: Derive the kernel file list from the design (data_movement ops: reader/[relayout]/writer) instead of a fixed reader/compute/writer triple.
